item.hellfire.strike_radio.tooltip: Right-click a block to call a plane. Sneak-use strikes the nearest flare.
item.hellfire.tactical_missile.tooltip: Right-click to launch at the block you look at. Sneak-use toggles fires.
item.hellfire.nuclear_charge.tooltip: Place to arm a short fuse. Devastates a large area.
item.hellfire.flare.tooltip: Places a beam that marks where the plane should hit.
